rows.label: tlk47100071_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I thought just a little
would be okay...

rows.label: tlk47100071_02_msg0002
rows.name:
You can understand me?!
Huh, you're an unusual person.

rows.label: tlk47100071_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I heard that pretty Blade who used
to come here died...

rows.label: tlk47100071_02_msg0004
rows.name:
She tried to pet me before, but I ran
away even though she was trying to
be gentle...

rows.label: tlk47100071_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I thought I might let her pet me
a little next time she came...
It's sad.
